notes.title: The Chills Update #3 - Wall Clipping Issues And Bugs fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Developer here! Today, I have uploaded a new updated build of The Chills game. First of all, thank you very much for your support! I hope you are enjoying the game and will continue to be a part of this awesome Steam community.

Today, I have fixed wall clipping issues which got reported by some of the players. I also have fixed the minor bugs which were present in the game. I hope you can now play the game without facing any annoying bug. 

But if you encounter issues or bugs please feel free to let me know by creating a thread in the discussion section. I will take a look and fix them with the next update. 

It has been an awesome learning experience for me and it was my first (only horror) title and I have never imagined that it would be liked by most users. Thank you very much for giving this game a try.

Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #2 - Player Controls Bug Fixed!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I am really glad to announce that I have just pushed a new update today fixing the bugs regarding player's controls because it was not working as intended to. This is a [b]"Day 2 update"[/b] after release. I will continue to fix them one after another as soon as possible.

I have received feedback from the users stating the issues regarding the player's controls. For example, if "A" and "Left arrow" keys are pressed at the same time the speed of the player movement was increasing by *2 times when moving to the left and same was happening when the controller button and keys are pressed at the same time. 

I have successfully fixed the bug and the controls are working as intended. 

[b]Issues Fixed:
- Some minor bugs.
- Player's movement controls bug. Even if you press for example. both "D" and "Right arrow" and "analogue stick right" of the gamepad the speed of the player's movement should remain the same.[/b]

Thank you very much to your patience! I will keep updating the game and fixing more issues. If you encounter any bug please feel free to let me know in the comments or create a new discussion thread. Thanks again!

Best Regards,
Anamik

notes.title: Update #1 - Save And Load Feature
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It has come to my notice that some players were asking for a "Save And Load" feature of the game. So, I decided to push an update on the Day 1 of the release with the most demanded feature for the game, The Chills.

[b]Fixes:
- Fixed some minor bugs.
- Added Auto-Save and Load feature. [/b]

Auto-Saves are given to levels where it is supposed to be present and it should help players to finish the game without any trouble. The advantage of this feature is that you don't have to start over from the beginning as I realized that it can be very frustrating for the player.

When the game is auto-saved you will receive a message saying "Game Auto-Saved". 

[b]To load the saved level:

Go to the Main Menu > Select "Load Game"> Then Select the saved progress you would like to load. [/b]

Thank you very much for taking your time to play the game and thank you very much for your support! This game could not be possible without your support.

If you encounter further issues please feel free to get in touch with me. I am here to help you out.

I will release more updates in the future. Thanks to your patience!

Best Regards,
Anamik
